content.context: Found that three invalid records in portfolio froze its whole SQLite/FTS projection: rebuild refuses to run when validate_all or the Project Intelligence doctor reports anything, so pitmry context returned NO_MATCH for every query while the canonical files stayed readable. Three of the 305 records were written by an external antigravity bridge that bypassed PITMRY validation, two with stale content hashes and one carrying a foreign source_artifact shape. Added a repair script, excluded lifecycle transitions from retrieval, and added a grouped stream density.
content.decision: Repair only stale hashes and unmapped enum values, and backfill a source artifact from the file its own metadata names; leave anything else untouched rather than inventing history.
content.rationale: A view that quietly drops records to look tidier is worse than a cluttered one, so grouping is proved lossless by a check script. Lifecycle transitions describe how a record moved rather than what is true, so they stay canonical but are indexed with empty text and filtered from retrieval.

summary: Repair only stale hashes and unmapped enum values, and backfill a source artifact from the file its own metadata names; leave anything else untouched rather than inventing history.
title: Unblock rebuild and group lifecycle bookkeeping
